candidate_reduction_notes: Consider reducing only validated, low-risk `pan:traffic` allow/end session records for sanctioned applications and trusted zones after confirming detections do not depend on them.
Always retain deny/block, threat, wildfire, system, config, auth, GlobalProtect, decryption, tunnel, correlation, and unknown/fallback families unless a local evidence-backed exception is approved.
lossy_behavior.must_retain_by_default: security signals, denials/failures, privileged/admin changes, detections, unknown/unclassified event families, and raw vendor context unless local validation approves otherwise

notes: PAN-OS traffic logs are typically very high volume; however threat/config/auth/system families are high-value and must be retained by default.

transforms: annotate template id/status only by default
optional local allowlist/drop predicates require validation before enablement

rollback: Disable or detach the Edge Processor pipeline template
route source directly to the original Splunk destination/index
replay a held-out sample to verify full-fidelity ingestion restored
retain pre/post event counts and affected search evidence

source.name: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS/Panorama syslog CSV

validation_required: Edge Processor preview parses module and sample source
replay fixture and representative production-equivalent sample
destination read-back verifies event count, sourcetype/source/index, timestamps, required normalized fields, and retained raw context
compare detection/search results before and after reduction
